steps.text: An ant bite injects formic acid into your skin — that's what causes the sting. Let's see how to relieve it.
Tap “Simulate Bite” to feel the acid sting.
Notice the pain — it comes from the acid the ant injected.
Now tap “Apply Treatment” to rub on baking soda (a base).
The pain fades — the base neutralises the formic acid: Acid + Base → Salt + Water + relief! That's neutralisation in daily life.

coach.mission: Soothe the ant bite by neutralising the acid.
whenStuck: The sting is acid — a base will neutralise it.
whenWrong: The sting is formic acid; apply a BASE (baking soda) to neutralise it.
whenCorrect: Relief! The base neutralised the acid.
That's neutralisation working on your skin.
coach.done: You've treated an acid sting with a base. Explore more, or move on.
